# weka_user (Data Source)

Look up an existing user by UID or username. The API does not return the password, so it stays null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weka_user" "s3" {
  username = "s3user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) User UID. Exactly one of id or username is required.
- `username` (String) User name. Exactly one of id or username is required.

### Read-Only

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Not returned by the API; always null here.
- `posix_gid` (Number) POSIX GID for this user's S3 files.
- `posix_uid` (Number) POSIX UID for this user's S3 files.
- `role` (String) Role of the user.
